description: Compare laser treatments in {{laserLocations}} for hair reduction and skin texture. Learn why the device, your skin tone and sun exposure matter.
answer: Laser treatments use focused light for specific skin or hair concerns. At {{brand}} in {{laserLocations}}, patients can discuss hair reduction or have uneven texture and pigmentation assessed. Hair reduction and resurfacing use different devices. Skin tone, tanning and the diagnosis guide whether a procedure is appropriate.
preparation: We check your skin tone, hair or pigment concern, medical history and recent sun exposure.
howPerformed: Laser devices use focused light to target structures such as hair follicles or pigment. Different concerns need different devices and settings, so the first step is to assess your skin and the area you want to treat.
followup: Redness, warmth or sensitivity may occur after laser treatment. Recovery depends on the device, settings and area. We will explain sun protection, which skincare products to pause and when you can resume your usual activities.
suitability: Hair colour, skin tone, recent tanning and medical history affect suitability. Pigmentation also needs assessment before treatment. We will explain the options and whether a test area is needed.
outlook: Hair reduction usually develops over several sessions because hair grows in cycles. Skin treatment results depend on the concern and device used. We will review your response before adjusting the plan.

faqs.a: You may feel brief heat or a snapping sensation. Cooling can help, but sensitivity varies by area and person. Tell the team how it feels so they can check your comfort throughout.

faqs.q: Is laser safe for darker skin tones?
faqs.a: Some laser devices and settings can suit darker skin tones, but assessment is essential. We will consider your skin type, tanning and the risks of burns or pigment changes before recommending treatment.

faqs.q: Why do I need multiple sessions?
faqs.a: Hair grows in cycles, and actively growing hairs tend to respond more readily. Several sessions are usually needed. The number and spacing depend on the area, hair characteristics and your response.

faqs.q: How many visits might I need?
faqs.a: 6 to 8 sessions (with the plan reviewed as you go)

faqs.q: Can I go back to my usual routine afterwards?
faqs.a: Redness, warmth or sensitivity may occur after laser treatment. Recovery depends on the device, settings and area. We will explain sun protection, which skincare products to pause and when you can resume your usual activities.

faqs.q: Can I have treatment if my skin marks easily?
faqs.a: A history of prolonged irritation or dark marks affects planning. Tell the team how your skin healed after previous procedures so the method and timing can be assessed.
Yes. The assessment is individual and takes account of your medical history, goals and the area of concern.
